description: Create an environment file for a Bruno collection. Writes the WHOLE file, so it REFUSES a name that already exists rather than overwriting it — the error names the existing variables and which ones a replace would delete, so you can merge with update_environment, pick another name, or retry with overwrite: true.

collectionPath.description: Absolute path to existing collection directory.

overwrite.description: Replace an environment that already exists. Without this an existing name is refused. Keys in the file that this tool does not model are preserved either way.

variables.description: Either a flat name-to-value map, or a list of variable objects when you need flags. Use the list form to declare a secret at create time: a secret variable is stored as a name only (no format persists a secret's value), so `value` is dropped for it.

name: create_environment
title: Create Bruno Environment
